\[
g(s)=\frac{(s+1)(s+2)}{s(s+3)(s+4)}=\frac{A}{s}+\frac{B}{s+3}+\frac{C}{s+4}
\]

Using the cover-up method:

- \(A=\left.\frac{(s+1)(s+2)}{(s+3)(s+4)}\right|_{s=0}=\frac{2}{12}=\frac16\)
- \(B=\left.\frac{(s+1)(s+2)}{s(s+4)}\right|_{s=-3}=\frac{2}{-3}=-\frac23\)
- \(C=\left.\frac{(s+1)(s+2)}{s(s+3)}\right|_{s=-4}=\frac{6}{4}=\frac32\)

So

\[
g(s)=\frac{1/6}{s}-\frac{2/3}{s+3}+\frac{3/2}{s+4}
\]
